title: Joint user-item allocation for e-commerce marketing campaigns
abstract: arXiv:2606.09623v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Web platforms run many marketing campaigns at once, and for each one they must decide which products to promote and which users to target. The best users depend on the products, and the best products on the users. The campaigns also compete with one another, because each user and each item may belong to only one of them and each audience is capped by the campaign budget. Still, existing approaches fix one side and search the other, choosing an assortment and then looking for its audience, or ranking items for one user at a time. Either way they solve a restricted version of the full problem, implying that a jointly optimized assignment would be at least as good and possibly far better. What the restriction costs, and whether the joint problem is solvable at the scale campaigns are run, remain unknown. translated_title: 电子商务营销活动中的用户-商品联合分配
translated_abstract: 网络平台同时开展众多营销活动，每一场活动都需要决定推广哪些商品以及定向哪些用户。最优的用户选择取决于商品，而最优的商品选择又取决于用户。各活动之间还存在相互竞争，因为每个用户和每件商品只能归属于其中一场活动，且每场活动的受众规模受其预算上限约束。然而，现有方法都是固定一方再搜索另一方：要么先选定商品组合再寻找目标受众，要么逐个用户地对商品进行排序。无论哪种方式，它们都只解决了完整问题的一个受限版本，这意味着联合优化的分配方案至少不会更差，甚至可能好得多。这种限制造成的损失有多大，以及联合问题能否在营销活动的实际运行规模上求解，目前仍不得而知。在本文中，我们将该联合任务形式化为“自动定向”：将用户和商品同时分配给多个互不重叠、容量受限的营销活动……
tldr: 该论文首次将电子商务营销活动中的商品选择与用户定向统一形式化为“自动定向”联合分配问题，突破了现有方法固定一方、单独优化另一方的局限，在多场互斥且预算受限的活动中实现用户与商品的联合优化分配。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the joint allocation of users and items across multiple disjoint, budget-capped e-commerce marketing campaigns as "auto-targeting," overcoming the limitations of existing approaches that fix one side while optimizing the other.
